trackpad.title: Trackpad
trackpad.description: Control your computer with smooth touch gestures. Move the cursor, click, scroll and navigate naturally.

keyboard.description: Type directly from your phone using a full remote keyboard designed for your computer.

music.title: Media controls

apps.title: App switching

connection.title: How to connect
connection.description: Open Taptiva on your Mac or Windows PC and scan the QR code with your iPhone or Android phone. Your phone connects directly to your computer over your local network.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Taptiva requires Accessibility permission on macOS to control your Mac. Open System Settings, then Privacy & Security → Accessibility, and enable Taptiva.

connectionProblems.title: Connection problems
connectionProblems.description: Make sure your computer and phone are connected to the same local network. If necessary, reconnect by scanning the QR code again.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Taptiva uses a direct local connection between your phone and computer for remote control. No account is required.

support.title: Enjoying Taptiva?

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: Taptiva is a remote touch control application for Mac and Windows. It allows users to control their computer using an iPhone or Android device over a local network.
overview.p2: Taptiva's core remote control functionality does not require an account or cloud service.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.p1: Taptiva is local-first. Your phone connects directly to your Mac or Windows PC over your local network. No account or cloud connection is required for remote control.
dataCollection.p2: Our website uses Google Analytics to understand website usage and improve Taptiva.

localNetwork.title: Local Network Communication
localNetwork.p1: Taptiva communicates directly between your computer and your mobile device over your local network.
localNetwork.p2: Information exchanged during this connection is used to provide the remote control functionality of the application.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Permission
accessibility.p1: On macOS, Taptiva requires Accessibility permission to perform remote control actions on your Mac, such as interacting with the mouse, keyboard, and other supported system controls.
accessibility.p2: This permission is managed by macOS and can be revoked at any time in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.p1: Our website uses Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google LLC.
thirdParty.p2: Google Analytics is used to measure website usage and understand how visitors interact with Taptiva's website. We do not use Google Analytics for advertising or remarketing unless this Privacy Policy is updated to reflect such use.
thirdParty.p3: Google Analytics may use cookies and other identifiers to provide its measurement services. The use of these technologies may be subject to applicable privacy and consent requirements depending on the visitor's location.
thirdParty.p4: Taptiva does not use third-party advertising services on this website.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.description: Taptiva does not knowingly collect personal information from children or other users.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page with an updated effective date.
